messages:
maya_csm: heads-up: CascadeForms renewal ~34d out. MAU down ~58% last 30d. Main champion promoted out of role yesterday.

alerts-bot: Usage drop alert for acct_cascadeforms: -58% (30d) vs baseline. Alert ID: UDA-20260428-03.

eli_ae: any sign they opened an RFP or talked to a competitor? procurement mentioned a brief demo with "FormLogic" last week.

noah_se: integration health shows repeated 502 on webhook validation between 3278901100-3278901120. also intermittent 429 on generate. quick excerpt: ```
2026-04-28T12:05:10Z WARN 502 /v1/webhook acct=cascadeforms req=hb-12
2026-04-28T12:05:12Z ERROR 429 /v1/generate acct=cascadeforms pid=gw-02
```

maya_csm: new PM listed as "T. O'Neal" in Okta but no response to outreach. I'll try again.

fran_manager: plan: (1) infra triage to confirm if errors caused lost requests; (2) offer quick SE rescue + adoption workshop; (3) propose a short commercial incentive if they move decision window. Prioritize 1.

noah_se: running health audit now, ETA 3h. If errors on our edge we'll backfill and provide a remediation note.

eli_ae: draft outreach to T: "Noticed significant drop and Sam's transition. Can we schedule 30m to triage integration and blocker list? We can assign SE hours this week." Approve?

maya_csm: approve. Also add: "We're investigating transient gateway errors and will share next steps."

fran_manager: approved retention package to propose after triage: 10 SE hours + 1-month credit on dedicated capacity for a 6mo renewal. Keep numbers flexible til we know severity.

alerts-bot: Reminder: create renewal_watch ticket in Salesforce (acct_cascadeforms, renewal_34d)  ticket #RW-20260428-21.

maya_csm: created SF ticket RW-20260428-21 and linked onboarding-rescue playbook. Will update when audit complete. :white_check_mark:
